svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: percent-off versus a points multiplier on 100 dollars
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs. A made-up 10 percent off a made-up 100 dollar basket is 10 dollars. A made-up 20-times multiplier on 15 points per dollar is like 30 dollars at 10,000 points like 10 dollars. Not a seniors-day rate.
svg.text: 10% and 20 times are made up. Redemption rate is from the benefits table.
20 times 15 points is 300 points per dollar. On $100 that is 30,000 points.
30,000 points at $10 per 10,000 is $30. Not a Shoppers seniors offer.
Saving Optimizer. Example with made-up inputs. Checked 29 Sep 2026.
